values.meaning: bonus true damage dealt to Cursed targets from incoming pre-mitigation magic damage
values.quote: receive {{sti|{{as|10% '''bonus''' true damage}}}} from all incoming {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} {{as|magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: Amumu's basic attacks and Curse of the Sad Mummy mark enemies with Curse, refreshing on subsequent applications and per-tick damage from Despair.
mechanics.quote: are empowered to mark enemies with ''Curse'' for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and ''{{ais|Despair|Amumu}}'' per-tick damage.

mechanics.claim: The bonus true damage applies to any incoming pre-mitigation magic damage from any source, amplifying magic damage dealt to Cursed targets.
mechanics.quote: receive {{sti|{{as|10% '''bonus''' true damage}}}} from all incoming {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} {{as|magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: If Amumu's basic attack applies on-hit magic damage, Curse is applied before that magic damage lands, so it does not amplify its own triggering hit.
mechanics.quote: If the triggering basic attack from '''Amumu''' applies {{as|magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, ''Curse'' will be applied before the {{as|magic damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Curse from Curse of the Sad Mummy is applied after its magic damage is dealt, so it only amplifies that hit if the target was already Cursed beforehand.
mechanics.quote: The ''Curse'' application from ''{{ai|Curse of the Sad Mummy|Amumu}}'' happens after the {{as|magic damage}} is dealt by it, therefore amplifying the damage only if the target was also already marked before the hit.

mechanics.claim: Curse application from Curse of the Sad Mummy is negated if the ability is blocked by a spell shield.
mechanics.quote: The application of ''Curse'' on ''{{ai|Curse of the Sad Mummy|Amumu}}'' is negated if the ability is blocked by a {{tip|spell shield}}.
